text:
What We Found
March 2025 Downtown Development Authority

•   Compliance gaps with statute and city code
•   Public perception and relations issues
•   A brand-new Plan of Development with unclear strategy for
    implementation
•   Multiple structural iterations (standalone, merged with other
    organizations, back to City) each leaving disruption
    unresolved

Overall: an organization that resembled a dilapidated house more
than a thriving home.

We need to rebuild the foundation before we can build                     The Cheyenne DDA:
anything else.                                                      Good bones, lots of work needed.
